pillar_reactions.evidence: No pillar was delivered — the call was disqualified on budget before the presentation. Training appeared only as a one-line feature of the cheap tier: 'a community with full programs that you can follow'. The prospect had already validated the method himself off free content: 'My mobility is crazy now. My athleticism has gone up a lot.'

Listed as a feature of the community tier — 'also nutrition guidelines' — and never presented. This is the pillar that mattered most for this prospect, whose stated problem is that he cannot eat enough, and it was never explained.

anchors.raw: Not a lot. But it can be 10 bucks... Pretty much free, almost.
anchors.note: Not an anchor against a competitor but an absolute ceiling near zero. Stated plainly when asked, which is what allowed the rep to end the call honestly and quickly.

anchors.raw: My mobility is crazy now. My athleticism has gone up a lot, too. I feel more athletic with everything I'm doing.
anchors.note: The fourth prospect in this batch already getting real results from the provider's free content before any conversation about paying. Two months of free Instagram work produced improvements he describes as dramatic, which makes the paid version an upgrade rather than a solution.

anchors.raw: I saw him on Instagram... Joe Rogan do it, too, and I was like, alright, I have to dial in.
anchors.note: Interest was generated by celebrity association and social proof rather than by a problem, which explains why the goals work never found any depth — there was no underlying pain driving it.

unmet_demand.want: Structured training and nutrition programming at close to zero cost
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The cheapest product is $200 a month against a stated budget of roughly nothing. There is no free or low-cost tier below the community subscription, so the funnel has no destination for this prospect other than the free social content he is already using.

unmet_demand.want: Help eating enough to gain weight when appetite is absent and eating is restricted
unmet_demand.why_unmet: This is his actual problem and the programme plausibly addresses it, but nobody explored it and the nutrition pillar was never presented. Whether the offer serves a hardgainer with a genuinely narrow diet was left completely untested.
